question_cn: 双兵各在两翼（王翼和后翼）的竞赛，决定胜负的关键因素是：
question_en: Two pawns racing on opposite wings — the key deciding factor is:

options.text_en: Which pawn is closer to promotion

options.text_cn: 哪方的王更靠近中心，能同时支援两翼
options.text_en: Whose king is more centrally placed to support both wings

options.text_cn: 哪个兵级别更高（a兵比b兵强）
options.text_en: Which pawn is ranked higher (a-pawn beats b-pawn)
The side to move always wins

explanation_cn: 分翼竞赛的元思维：王在中心是最大优势，因为能灵活支援任意一翼。反应时间（"距离差"）决定胜负——这是王活跃性原则在多兵残局中的最高体现。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: centralized king is the biggest advantage in wing races — it can respond to either wing. The 'distance differential' determines the winner. This is king activity at its highest level.
